fusions.name: Rolling Thud
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 14 damage and is stunned for 1.2 seconds. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Tack Strike
fusions.desc: A thrown stinger that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tinker Crew
fusions.desc: Calls a minion that fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each strike has a 35% chance of [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drive Home
fusions.desc: When you strike, your damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Fighting beside others pays: +11% per ally within 5.5 tiles, capped at 4.
